# Study 1: Claude panel vs GPT replication (generated by src/s1_cross_family.py)

Five original tasks. Raw scale in percentage points of task score; SD scale standardised within model x task.
Equal weight per block is study 1's estimator; equal weight per model treats each model once.
Family difference = GPT - Claude, equal weight per model; p from an exact permutation over the 70 splits of the eight models into two groups of four. Exploratory.
